01 / The gap

Most growing businesses already have a website, WhatsApp, email, spreadsheets, forms and several software tools.

Your tools exist.
They should work together.

The problem is that they often work separately.

Leads arrive but are not followed up quickly. Customer information is copied manually between tools. Staff repeat the same admin every week. A website looks acceptable but does not give people a clear reason to enquire.

The result is not always a technical failure. It is lost time, missed opportunities and a business that works harder than it should.
Request a digital systems review → We discuss the review live during the call.
02 / The arrangement

One partner. One plan. Better systems over time.

You are not hiring several disconnected freelancers for your website, automation, CRM and internal workflows. You are working with one partner that understands how these parts should work together.

Build what matters

We start with a real business priority: a weak website, missed leads, repeated manual work, disconnected tools or a team that needs practical AI guidance.

Connect the right tools

We connect the systems you already use where possible, so customer and operational information reaches the right person or place without unnecessary manual work.

Automate repeated work

We identify useful opportunities to reduce copying, chasing, reporting and follow-up through practical automation and AI-assisted workflows.

Improve continuously

For monthly partners, we use an agreed capacity allocation to improve the highest-priority area each month.

Fully remote

We work remotely across Ghana and West Africa through structured communication, calls and screen sharing. We focus on digital systems, not physical-device repair, printer servicing, office cabling or on-site network installation.

04 / Continuity

A project can end. Improvement should not.

Many businesses complete a website or automation project, then return to the same disconnected processes months later.

The tools change, customer expectations grow and small problems become routine workarounds.

That is why Dakyworld works monthly rather than by the project. The build is delivered, and then it keeps being improved — agreed priorities, transparent capacity and a review every month.

08 / Before you ask

Straight answers before you start.

Do we need a monthly partnership to work with Dakyworld?+

Yes. Dakyworld works on monthly partnerships only. A website, automation, integration or workshop is delivered as an early priority within a partnership rather than as a one-off, so the work keeps improving after it goes live.

Do you replace our internal IT team?+

No. Dakyworld focuses on digital systems and automation: websites, customer journeys, workflows, integrations and adoption. We do not provide office hardware support, device repair, network installation or managed cybersecurity services.

Can you work with our existing tools?+

Usually, yes. We begin by understanding your current website, forms, CRM, WhatsApp, email, calendar and operating processes. We then recommend the simplest practical improvements.

What happens if we need work beyond the monthly allocation?+

We explain the requirement, estimate the work and provide a separate written proposal before starting. Nothing outside the agreed scope begins without your approval.

What happens if we decide to stop?+

After the initial three-month Founding Partner period or any other agreed initial term, monthly partnerships can end with 30 days' written notice. Your business retains ownership of its accounts, domains, source files and data.
